Test these items: empty(), exists([criteria]), all(criteria), allTrue(), anyTrue(), allFalse(), anyFalse(), subsetOf(other), supersetOf(other), count(), distinct(), isDistinct(). issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath Normative Release 5.1.2 exists([criteria]) and 5.2.1 where(criteria)
issues.evidence: EXPLORER probe .temp/qa/fp03_explorer_rerun_probe.py: native fhirpath_bool(resource, 'nested.exists(flags)') returned true while forced Python fallback returned NULL/empty. Resource has nested[0].flags=[true] and nested[1].flags=[false,true]. The spec defines exists(criteria) as shorthand for where(criteria).exists(); where(criteria) signals an error when a condition is other than a single Boolean. Native short-circuits on the first true criterion and never validates the later multi-item Boolean criterion.
issues.root_cause: Native evalExists returned immediately after the first true criteria result, so it implemented a short-circuit any() rather than the spec-defined where(criteria).exists() behavior that validates every criteria result.
issues.resolution: Changed native evalExists to evaluate and validate all criteria results, remember whether any item matched, restore loop scope on normal and exceptional exits, and return the final Boolean only after full validation. Added native SQL and native/fallback DuckDB parity regressions.
issues.verified_in: .temp/qa/fp03_explorer_rerun_probe_after_fix.log; extensions/fhirpath native unittest 344 assertions; pytest test_existence_parity.py 11 passed; focused parity slices 58 passed; full conformance 2822/2822

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath Normative Release 5 Functions expression arguments and 6.5 logical operators
issues.evidence: EXPLORER probe .temp/qa/fp03_explorer_rerun_probe.py: forced Python fallback fhirpath_is_valid('a.all(($this > 0) and ($index < 3))') returned false while native returned true and both evaluated to true. The fallback unknown-function scanner treats the logical operator token before '(' as an unknown function name ('and'), even though criteria arguments are arbitrary FHIRPath expressions and 'and' is an operator.
issues.root_cause: The fallback unknown-function regex scanned operator tokens followed by an opening parenthesis and classified logical operators such as 'and (' as unknown function calls.
issues.resolution: Updated fallback unknown-function scanning to ignore FHIRPath operator keywords before parenthesized operands unless they appear as actual function-style calls. Added native/fallback fhirpath_is_valid parity coverage for parenthesized logical criteria.
